Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: California Software Company Limited issued its Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26, convening its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The management detailed agenda items including the adoption of audited financial statements, the retirement of a director by rotation, and the re-appointment of directors and independent directors. The document outlines procedures for electronic voting and participation through video conferencing or other audio-visual means. Management focused its strategy in fiscal year 2024-25 on empowering small and microbusinesses through accessible, AI-driven solutions to democratize advanced technology. The company invested in AI platforms such as dSpeedUp, dRyZe CRM, dBotMinds, and Zaywoo to assist small entrepreneurs with online sales, customer service, marketing, and operational efficiency.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.
demand_outlook.quote: This growth validated our thesis that there is enormous latent demand in the small business segment for technology that is both powerful and practical.

orders_capacity.claim: Management reported that dSpeedUp's digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants.
orders_capacity.quote: dSpeedUp’s digital ecosystem grew to serve over 1000 merchants, achieving 95% annual client retention as small retailers and service providers embraced the platform’s benefits..

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, many small enterprises still face resource and expertise gaps in deploying AI effectively.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Duraiswamy Basuvaiah is re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term of five consecutive years.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as an Independent Director of the Company for a second term, not liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vijayakumar Madhavan is re-appointed as a Director for a term of five consecutive years.
management_commitments.quote: re-appointed as a Non-Executive, Non Independent Director, liable to retire by rotation, for a term of five consecutive years commencing from July 31,2026 up to July 30,2031.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that Calsoft's mission in FY 2024-25 centered on democratizing advanced technology for startups, retailers, local service providers, and microentrepreneurs.
management_commitments.quote: Calsoft’s mission in FY 2024–25 centered on democratizing advanced technology for the “fortune five million” – the startups, mom-and-pop retailers, local service providers, and microentrepreneurs that form the backbone of the economy.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support.
management_commitments.quote: The Company invested heavily in AI-powered platforms tailored to small business needs, introduced affordable pricing models, and provided training and support to lower barriers to adoption.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
